_about: Public guidance documents that the 'Ask the guidelines' search indexes. This file lists where each document comes from and under which licence; the documents themselves are never stored in the package or the repository. scripts/fetch_corpus.py downloads them into .cache/corpus/ and, with --update-manifest, records each file's SHA-256 and the UTC date it was retrieved. Sources and licence terms come from the corpus and licence research of 2026-09-23.
